combo_label: Around the House × The Circus × Frankenstein

entries.clue: The one you ring at midnight when a pipe bursts under the boards
Roofed shelter over a front door, where parcels wait out of the rain
Single-wheeled pedal machine ridden with no handlebars at all
Well-spoken, as the novel's being is, though the 1931 monster is mute
Electricity from chemical action, a word the 1831 text actually uses
Mean shack against a cottage wall where the being hides and listens
Stage name of Nicolai Poliakoff, long the star turn at Bertram Mills's circus
Glass-filled frame that swings open sideways like a small door
Spread beneath the flying act, so that a missed catch ends in a bounce
Cranny's partner in the old phrase; on its own, a tucked-away corner
Pitched canvas, struck after the final night and raised again in the next town
Woodland fruit the being lives on, with berries, while in hiding
